description: What registering a knowledge base takes: everything a registered one holds but its id, which the client's list makes. It has a did, because registering follows a sign-in: the knowledge base has already said what it is.

label.description: What a person reads the knowledge base as. Once the knowledge base has described itself, its own name.

did.description: The did the knowledge base reported of itself.

lastRead.description: The last time the knowledge base described itself. Absent until it has, in an answer that carried this entry's did.
